headline: Four families, four corrections, no approvals. Two are artifact-clean and blocked only by absent source bytes. Two carry real defects in the bytes, and the deeper fact under both is that no family was re-rendered: the maps are corrected and the artifacts are not.
independence: This reviewer did not create any artifact, sidecar, raster, map, classification or shared correction reviewed here. The batch-1 record was read for its findings and left untouched; no batch-1 verdict was copied forward, and each verdict below was reached from the evidence at this head.

theOneFindingThatMattersMost.finding: The Gate B rerender processed zero families, and the record produced from it nonetheless marks per-family objections as provenAgainstThisFamilysBytes: true.
theOneFindingThatMattersMost.evidence: gate-b-family-rerender-evidence.json records rerenderAttempt.result as 'ran to completion and processed 0 families, 0 fields, 0 contact sheets', artifactsChanged: 0, privateCorpusMountedInThisClone: false, and newArtifactSha256 equal to currentCanonicalArtifactSha256 for all 17 families. Its own notAnApproval field says 'no objection is proven against any family's own bytes, because no family's bytes changed.' The families[] array then sets provenAgainstThisFamilysBytes: true on 28 objections.
theOneFindingThatMattersMost.whyItMatters: KY:aoc-334-form-en is the case that shows the cost. Its map refuses 'Court' and 'Date'; its artifact writes to both. A reader trusting the per-family field would conclude the geometry correction had reached the bytes. It has not.
theOneFindingThatMattersMost.smallestCorrection: In gate-b-family-rerender-evidence.json, set provenAgainstThisFamilysBytes to false wherever no re-render occurred, so the field agrees with the notAnApproval statement directly above it. That record is not this reviewer's to edit.

crossFamilyFindings.observed: All four canonical artifact hashes at this head equal the hashes gate-b recorded before its rerender attempt. Nothing was regenerated.
crossFamilyFindings.consequence: Where a shared correction changed the map, the artifact no longer agrees with it. AK tf-800 and tf-805 happen to agree anyway because their pre-correction render already refused certDate's companion and the corrected map only formalised the refusal; the two KY families do not agree.
crossFamilyFindings.required: Re-render every family against the corrected binder before any family is put forward for approval again.

crossFamilyFindings.observed: reports/protected-fields-scan.json reports pass: true for both. For aoc-334 it counts 7 written fields against a map declaring 5 bindings; for aoc-496-3 it counts 1 against a map declaring 2. It never compares the two numbers, so both an undeclared write and a silently dropped write pass it.
crossFamilyFindings.required: The scan compares written fields against declared bindings and fails on either direction of mismatch.
crossFamilyFindings.smallestCorrection: Add a written-versus-bound reconciliation to the scan. One check catches both defects.

crossFamilyFindings.observed: ESC-MANUAL-NOT-NEVER-WRITE added the literal class 'manual' to NEVER_WRITE. Field 'Text1' is classified 'unused' and is bound and written.
crossFamilyFindings.required: NEVER_WRITE is expressed as an allowlist of writable classes rather than a denylist of one, so a new class name cannot reopen the hole.
crossFamilyFindings.smallestCorrection: Write to participant classes only; refuse everything else by default.

crossFamilyFindings.observed: The rendered evidence for every multi-page family is a single 1342x930 PNG carrying page 1 of the contact sheet and a sliver of page 2. AK tf-800 is 3 pages, AK tf-805 is 2, KY aoc-496-3 is 3. The Certificate of Service, notarisation and judicial blocks all sit below the crop.
crossFamilyFindings.consequence: For AK tf-800 and tf-805 the certification line is exactly what the historical objection asked a reviewer to confirm blank, and it is not in the picture. Both were verified blank from the artifact bytes instead, and both hold.
crossFamilyFindings.required: Rasterise every page of the contact sheet, so the visual channel covers the protected blocks rather than page 1 alone.
crossFamilyFindings.note: Recorded as a batch-level evidence gap, not as a per-family correction, since batch-1 recorded the same crop and the areas concerned were verified by other means here.

crossFamilyFindings.observed: None of the four family packages carries an overlay-profile.json, and production-field-map.json carries no independentReview field. rcap-platform-ready.mjs reads the profile, so an approval recorded here has no channel to reach the gate.
crossFamilyFindings.consequence: Even a clean approval could not promote any of these four families today.

ownerDecisionEscalated.question: Should the platform fill this document at all?
ownerDecisionEscalated.observed: AOC-334 is ORDER VOIDING CONVICTION AND SEALING RECORDS. It recites that 'Defendant's conviction is hereby void', ends 'So ORDERED this ___ day of ___, 2___' over a Judge rule, and carries a CERTIFICATION block for an agency records custodian. It is an order the court issues, not a filing the participant completes. production-field-map.json types it documentOwnership 'participant_completed' with captionOnly false, so participant facts are bound throughout the body rather than to the caption alone.
ownerDecisionEscalated.whyItFallsThrough: Ownership is keyed on documentRole, filename slug and officialTitle, and the recorded officialTitle is the mid-sentence fragment above, which carries no order/judgment/decree token. Fixing the title (A-KY334-IDENTITY-UNRECORDED) may change the ownership determination as a side effect, which is a further reason to fix it deliberately rather than incidentally.
ownerDecisionEscalated.required: OWNERSHIP.COURT_ORDER with captionOnly engaged, if the product intends to prepare this form for a participant at all.
ownerDecisionEscalated.status: open — raised in batch-1, unresolved. Recorded here as an owner decision rather than a reviewer determination, because whether a court's own order is prepared for filing is a product and counsel question, not a rendering question.
ownerDecisionEscalated.note: This family's verdict is correction_required rather than substantive_owner_decision_required because the four corrections above are concrete defects that must be fixed whichever way the ownership question is decided.
